title: Say Hi!
description: Say hi to someone new in the community.

title: Go for a Walk
description: Take a walk outside and enjoy the fresh air.

title: Help Someone
description: Help someone with a task or problem they are facing.

title: Call Someone
description: Pick a person, ring them, use your actual voice. Texting does not count.

title: Ask About Being Nine
description: Ask someone what they were like at nine years old, then write down the part you did not expect.

rubric.ideal: I asked a coworker what she was like at nine and she talked for ten minutes without stopping.
She said she was obsessed with horses, wore the same red jacket every single day, and told everyone she was going to be a vet.
The part I did not expect was how loud that kid sounds. The person I know now is quiet and careful about everything.

title: Sit Somewhere Busy and Do Nothing
description: Find a bench where people actually pass, sit down, and stay fifteen minutes with your phone in your pocket. You are not waiting for anyone.

title: Ask Someone Behind a Counter What Nobody Asks
description: Wherever somebody is working today, ask them the part of the job people never ask about, then write down what they said.

rubric.ideal: I asked the woman running the till at the bakery on the corner, mid afternoon, when nobody else was in.
She said everyone asks about the bread and nobody ever asks about the four in the morning part, which is the only part that is actually hard.
It took me two goes to actually ask; the first time I bought a roll and left without saying anything.
